observation.command: cd /usr/local/bin && sed -i 's|enable) state_set "unit-${unit//\\//_}" enabled; \[ "$NOW" = 1 \] && do_start "$unit" ;;|enable) state_set "unit-${unit//\\//_}" enabled; if [ "$NOW" = 1 ]; then do_start "$unit"; fi ;;|; s|disable) state_set "unit-${unit//\\//_}" disabled; \[ "$NOW" = 1 \] && do_stop "$unit" ;;|disable) state_set "unit-${unit//\\//_}" disabled; if [ "$NOW" = 1 ]; then do_stop "$unit"; fi ;;|' systemctl && grep -n "enable)\|disable)" systemctl && bash -n systemctl && echo SYNTAX_OK
